limitations: Scans JS/MJS/CJS literal strings and template chunks, not runtime execution.
Skips assets, dev tools, scripts, tests, backups, build output and supabase.
Computed paths, HTML/JSON references and bundle IDs assembled from variables may be missed.
Literal bundle mentions do not prove a bundle is loaded, and no mention does not prove it is unused.
No network requests; checks local file existence, not MIME types or server routing.
